entities.name: Bicuspid aortic valve
observations: A 2016 study of 139 consecutive patients evaluated CBC-derived neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) and echocardiographic ejection fraction.

In the subgroup with ascending aortic diameter ≥3.9 cm, higher NLR correlated inversely with ejection fraction (r = −0.467, P = 0.033); subgroup size and adjusted estimates were not reported in the retrieved abstract.

entities.name: NLR-LVEF inverse correlation
observations: Among BAV patients with ascending aortic dilatation, higher neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio was associated with lower ejection fraction (r = −0.467, P = 0.033).
Evidence is limited to one observational study and a subgroup; it does not prove causation or establish the association in all BAV patients.
